text:
emily-zhou: Postmortem follow-up for Northstar dedicated cluster. Root cause: transient VPC peering flap + mismatched on-prem ACLs exposed a reconciliation race that briefly isolated tenant KV sync. Need clear owners, short timelines, and a durable mitigation for customers on private wiring.

rahul-narayan: Agreed. Let's break into concrete items and owners so we can track in INC-2274.

jordan-lee: I'll take the routing controller change to avoid delete/re-add races. Plan: implement per-peer apply lock + retry window. ETA prototype in 4 business days.

claire-wu: I'll own customer coordination and the on-prem validation checklist: required ACL rules, health port opening, and ephemeral port ranges. Will reach out to Northstar ops and get signoff in 48 hours.

emily-zhou: Proposed action list: 1) emergency mitigation: hold peering changes for active sessions (owner rahul) 2) routing controller fix (owner jordan) 3) on-prem checklist + signoff (owner claire) 4) alerting/metrics: peering_reconcile_failures + kv_sync_errors (owner rahul) 5) post-deploy verification job (owner rahul).

rahul-narayan: Assigning myself #1, #4, #5. I'll push a config rollout for holdback (canary) within 24h and add Grafana alert.

jordan-lee: Assigning #2. Technical note: avoid evicting KV on rollback; mark nodes read-only until sync completes. Pseudocode: acquire_peer_lock(); apply_acls(); wait_for_ack(); apply_routes(); release_lock(). If ack fails, revert routes and mark nodes read-only.

claire-wu: Assigning #3. Checklist draft: confirm peering CIDR allowed, open TCP 9000 for health, enable ephemeral range 30000-32000 for KV sync. I'll ask Northstar to allow a 2-hour maintenance window.

ops-bot: Linked incident INC-2274. Please reference in PRs.

emily-zhou: Timelines: mitigation by 24h (rahul), routing fix prototype in 4 business days (jordan), checklist + signoff in 2 business days (claire), alerts and verification job by 5 business days (rahul). Confirm if blockers.

rahul-narayan: I will open INC-2274-1 for mitigation config and tag owners. Will also add a quick canary verification job to assert KV sync after config.

jordan-lee: I'll include unit + integration tests simulating firewall 403 and delayed ACL ack. Will push PR and tag @rahul-narayan for review.

claire-wu: Northstar tentatively available Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC. I'll confirm and upload firewall logs.

emily-zhou: Also add an analytics job to scan past 90 days for peering flap + KV error correlations; owner rahul, ETA 7 days. That helps detect recurrence.

rahul-narayan: Acknowledged. I'll add the scan to INC-2274 backlog.

emily-zhou: Thanks all. Ops will add this to weekly incident review. Call out any slips here so we can adjust timelines. :thumbsup:
